ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota's Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the alleged fraud in Minnesota's Medicaid program and the entities involved.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to expose the network of individuals and organizations involved in the alleged fraud.
questions: Who are the key players involved?
What is the estimated amount of fraudulent funds?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme within Minnesota's Medicaid program, with significant implications for the state's healthcare system and economy.
